main_text.l: נָדִיב m. Spontaneus, Voluntarius: Ingenuus; Munificus: Princeps, à munifico affectu: plur. נְדִיבִים. Fœm. נְדִיבָה : plur. נְדִיבוֹת.
נִדְבָּר f. Voluntarium, Voluntaria oblatio: Sponte, Voluntariè.

נָדַד Vagari, Evagari, Errare, Fugere; Profugere. Chald. Prater. fœmin. נְדֵדַת Profugit; Recessit, Dan. 6. Pyhal נוֹדַד Movetur, Errat, Fugit. Hiphil הִנְדִּיד Fugavit. Hophal הֻדַּד Fugari. Hithpahel הִתְנוֹדֵד Vagum fugere, Evagari. Vide נוּד.
נִדָּה f. Separatio, Res seperanda propter impuritatem: Impuritas: & adjectivè, Impura, & Menstruata mulier, Impura ex menstruo, Menstruo laborans.
נָדַח Hiphil הֵדִיחַ Impellere, Dep. Disp. Exp. Vibrare. Niphal נִדַּח Depelli, Impelli. Pyhal Partic. נְדָּח Impulsus; Hophal Partic. הֻדַּח idem.

page.notes: Hebrew and Latin mixed; some vowel points and Hebrew forms are approximate. Heading-like words are set in the entry lines and transcribed as printed where legible. The bottom Hebrew word (מדוחים) is printed alone at the right.
